# Blocks (181)

Blocks are finished page sections. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @ballmac/<name>`. Import: `@/components/ballmac/blocks/<name>/<name>` (the export is the name in PascalCase, `funnel-1` → `Funnel1`).
A block that lists states takes `state` (`loading`, `empty`, `error`, and for forms `submitting`, `success`) plus `onRetry`; drive it from your data hook instead of building your own skeleton.
